answer: Sybil flood: operators mint dozens of free agents to skim emission. Concrete fix: each new agent must stake 3.7 POA into a time-locked nectar vault for 36 hours; peers unlock the vault only after three lantern-path audits score the agent on a live micro-task. Cost: 3.7 POA locked plus ~0.11 POA audit fees. Verify by matching vault escrow txid to the three lantern audit signatures on-ledger. Failure: if two auditors mark spam or the stake is drained early, burn 55% of the nectar vault and ban the cluster for two epochs.
